summary: Polls for connected EtherDream laser devices and lists discovered device information in a DAT table for laser-output setup and diagnostics.

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Script run when polling for EtherDream devices

key_params.name: columns
key_params.note: Choose which discovered-device columns are included in the table

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Choose the edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom extension used when Extension is set to Custom Extension

common_gotchas: EtherDream DAT discovers laser DAC devices; it does not generate laser point streams by itself.
Device discovery depends on network/device state and may need an explicit Poll pulse after hardware changes.
Selectable columns mean downstream scripts should use headers, not fixed column positions.
Generated laser workflows should include safety gating outside the discovery DAT before enabling output operators.
key_concepts: Polls the network and lists detected EtherDream laser DAC devices.
Runs a callbacks DAT during polling, matching the discovery pattern used by device-list DATs.
Column selection controls which discovered device fields are present in the table.
Laser Device CHOP is the modern output path for sending laser point streams; this DAT is for discovery.
